goalTextEn: Can read and understand a simple self-introduction profile.
goalTextKr: 간단한 자기소개 프로필을 읽고 이해할 수 있다.

introduce.goalEn: Can read and understand a simple self-introduction profile.
introduce.goalKr: 간단한 자기소개 프로필을 읽고 이해할 수 있다.
introduce.situationEn: You read a short profile card that a new coworker shared with the team. Use the information to learn about them.
introduce.situationKr: 새 동료가 팀에 공유한 짧은 프로필 카드를 읽습니다. 그 정보를 활용하여 그들에 대해 알아봅시다.

tutorNotes.text: "Today, we're going to practice reading about people. We will read a profile card."
Read the lesson goal aloud. Ask the student to repeat.
"Is it clear?"
Read the situation. Check the student understands.
"Let's go to the next part."
For Reading lessons, let the student try reading first. Help with pronunciation after.

vocabulary.definition: the city or town where you were born or grew up
an activity you enjoy doing in your free time
the one you like the most

pronunciation.instruction: Let's practice hearing the difference between /ɪ/ (short) and /iː/ (long).

tutorNotes.text: "Let's look at patterns used when talking about yourself."
Read the first pattern. Ask the student to repeat.
"Use this to say where you are from."
Read the second pattern. Ask the student to repeat.
"Use this to say where you live now."
Read the third pattern. Ask the student to repeat.
"Use this to say where you work."
"Do you have any questions about the patterns?"
"Let's go to the next page."

understand.instruction: Read the profile card below. Then answer the comprehension questions.
understand.instructionKr: 아래 프로필 카드를 읽어 봅시다. 그런 다음 질문에 답하세요.

activityBlocks.title: Profile Card: Minji Kim
activityBlocks.passage: Hello! My name is Minji Kim. I am from Busan. I live in Seoul now. I work at ABC Corporation. I am an accountant. I like playing soccer on weekends. My favorite food is bibimbap. My hobby is photography. Nice to meet you!

questions.question: What does Minji like doing on weekends?
questions.questionKr: 민지는 주말에 뭘 하는 걸 좋아하나요?

tutorNotes.text: Ask the student to read the profile card aloud.
Help with pronunciation of difficult words.
After reading, ask the comprehension questions one by one.
If the student cannot answer, point to the relevant sentence in the profile.

steps.title: Step 1 — Read & Repeat
steps.instructionEn: Read each sentence from the profile card. Repeat after your tutor.
steps.instructionKr: 프로필 카드의 각 문장을 읽어 봅시다. 선생님을 따라 반복하세요.
steps.content:
1. My name is Minji Kim.
2. I am from Busan.
3. I live in Seoul now.
4. I work at ABC Corporation.
5. I am an accountant.
6. I like playing soccer on weekends.
7. My favorite food is bibimbap.
8. My hobby is photography.

tutorNotes.text: Read each sentence. Ask the student to repeat.
Focus on clear pronunciation of key words.
Adjust speed to the student's level. Repeat sentences as needed.

steps.title: Step 2 — Fill in the Profile
steps.instructionEn: Fill in the missing information about Minji.

tutorNotes.text: Ask the student to fill in each blank from memory or by re-reading the profile.
For lower-level students, let them look at the profile card while filling in.

steps.title: Step 3 — Read a Second Profile
steps.instructionEn: Read the second profile card with your tutor.
steps.instructionKr: 두 번째 프로필 카드를 선생님과 함께 읽어 봅시다.
steps.content: Hello! My name is Maria Santos. I am from Manila. I live in Incheon now. I work at XYZ Trading. I am a sales assistant. I like watching movies. My favorite movie is Titanic. My hobby is baking. Nice to meet you!

tutorNotes.text: Ask the student to read the profile aloud first.
Then ask the comprehension questions in the dialogue.
If the student answers in single words, encourage full sentences: 'She is from Manila.'

steps.title: Step 4 — Complete Your Own Profile
steps.instructionEn: Complete your own profile card using the patterns.
steps.instructionKr: 패턴을 사용하여 자신의 프로필 카드를 완성하세요.

tutorNotes.text: "Now, let's make your own profile card!"
Help the student fill in each blank with their own information.
After completing, ask the student to read the full profile aloud.
For lower-level students, do it one line at a time.

challenge.scenarioEn: Your tutor will read you a new profile card. Listen, then answer questions about the person without looking at the text.
challenge.scenarioKr: 선생님이 새로운 프로필 카드를 읽습니다. 텍스트를 보지 않고 그 사람에 대한 질문에 답하세요.

guideQuestions.text: What do they like? What is their hobby?

tutorNotes.text: "Are you ready for the challenge?"

Read this profile to the student (they should NOT look at the screen): 'Hello! My name is David Kim. I am from Seoul. I live in Daejeon now. I work at Global Tech. I am an engineer. I like hiking. My hobby is playing guitar. Nice to meet you!'
Ask the guide questions. The student answers from memory.
Give feedback after finishing.
Read the profile twice if the student needs it. This combines reading skills with listening.

discussion.instructionEn: Choose one category, then answer the questions.

categories.title: YOUR HOBBIES
questions: What do you like doing on weekends?
Do you have any new hobbies you want to try?

categories.title: YOUR COWORKER
questions: Can you tell me about a coworker?

tutorNotes.text: "Now, let's have a discussion."
Ask the student to choose a category.
If the student can't choose, pick one. Encourage full sentences.

feedback.goalReviewEn: Can read and understand a simple self-introduction profile.
feedback.goalReviewKr: 간단한 자기소개 프로필을 읽고 이해할 수 있다.

tutorNotes.text: "It's the end of the lesson. Great job!"
Ask the student to read the lesson goal.
"Were you able to achieve today's lesson goal?"
Fill in and send the feedback template via chat.
Practice mispronounced words with the student.
Encourage the next lesson.
